mcqs.question: UPI was launched in Greece through a partnership between which of the following?
options: NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) and Eurobank
NIPL and the Asian Development Bank (ADB)
mcqs.explanation: UPI was launched in Greece through the partnership between NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) and Eurobank. NPCI and NSE Indices were not identified as the partners in this launch, while ADB’s role in the July 2026 news was an urban water and sanitation loan.
